note: Costs are rough per-person planning estimates for a group of six sharing rooms and transport, starting from Accra. Prices in Ghana change quickly, so check before booking.

destinations.name: Accra
destinations.tagline: Beach clubs, nightlife and the best food scene in the country.

fromAccra.how: You're already here. Get around by Uber, Bolt or Yango.

activities.name: Day trip to Aburi Botanical Gardens
Art Centre for crafts and gifts

food: Grilled tilapia and banku at the beach
Chop bars for fufu and light soup
destinations.stay: Shared Airbnb in Osu, Airport Residential or East Legon.
tips: Traffic is heavy at rush hour, so plan big moves for mornings or late evenings.
December is peak 'Detty December' season: book stays early and expect higher prices.

destinations.name: Cape Coast & Elmina
destinations.tagline: History, castles, rainforest canopy walks and chilled beach bars.

fromAccra.how: VIP or STC bus from Kaneshie or Circle, or a rented minibus with a driver for the group.

activities.name: Beach bars at Elmina or Anomabo

food: Fresh fish and kenkey by the sea
destinations.stay: Beach resorts or guesthouses between Cape Coast and Elmina.
tips: Do Kakum early in the morning before the heat and crowds.
The castle tours are emotional and worth doing with a guide.

destinations.name: Kumasi
destinations.tagline: Ashanti culture, kente villages, huge markets and Lake Bosomtwe.

fromAccra.how: VIP or STC bus from Accra, or a domestic flight if you find a deal.

activities.name: Kumasi nightlife on Adum and Ahodwo

destinations.stay: Guesthouses or hotels in Ahodwo or Nhyiaeso.
tips: Leave Accra early to beat traffic out of the city.
A local guide for the kente villages makes the visit much better.

destinations.name: Volta Region (Wli & Afadjato)
destinations.tagline: Ghana's highest waterfall, its highest mountain and monkey sanctuaries.

fromAccra.how: Bus or tro-tro to Hohoe, then taxis. A rented minibus is easiest for six.

activities.name: Wli Waterfalls hike (lower and upper falls)

destinations.stay: Lodges near Wli or guesthouses in Hohoe.
tips: Bring good shoes: the upper falls hike is steep.
December to January is dry season, so falls are smaller but trails are easier.

destinations.name: Ada Foah
destinations.tagline: Where the Volta River meets the sea: boat trips, jet skis and island chalets.

fromAccra.how: Short drive or tro-tro from Accra. Easy weekend escape.

activities.name: Boat cruise on the Volta estuary
Visit the Ada Estuary and turtle beaches

destinations.stay: Riverside resorts or island beach huts.
tips: Book island huts ahead for December weekends.
Bring cash: card machines are rare on the islands.

destinations.name: Busua & Akwidaa
destinations.tagline: Quiet surf beaches, lobster dinners and Cape Three Points.

fromAccra.how: Bus to Takoradi, then a taxi to Busua (about 45 minutes).

food: Seafood pizza at the beach spots
destinations.stay: Beach lodges in Busua or eco-lodges in Akwidaa.
tips: Swim only where the locals say it's safe; currents can be strong.
Long travel day each way, so 4 days works better than 3.

destinations.name: Mole National Park
destinations.tagline: Walking safaris with elephants, antelope and baboons.

fromAccra.how: Fly or take an overnight bus to Tamale, then about 3 hours by road to Mole.

activities.name: Larabanga Mosque (one of the oldest in West Africa)

destinations.stay: Zaina Lodge (luxury) or the Mole Motel (budget).
tips: The journey eats a day each way; 4 days is the minimum.
Dry season (Dec to Jan) is the best time to see elephants at the waterhole.

destinations.name: Akosombo
destinations.tagline: Lake Volta cruises, the Adomi Bridge and riverside resorts.

fromAccra.how: Short drive from Accra; tro-tros run regularly.

activities.name: Dodi Island cruise on Lake Volta
Pool and riverside chilling at a resort

destinations.stay: Riverside resorts around Akosombo and Atimpoku.
tips: Easy to combine with Ada or the Volta Region.
Weekend cruises fill up, so book ahead.
